cover.desc: Full color, and the loudest, warmest, most crowded image in the series. The Sakuragawa shotengai at night, transformed: paper lanterns strung on wires across the street between the awnings, a hand-painted cloth banner slung above the bathhouse entrance, folding tables and stalls down both sides — grilled corn, a tofu stall with a blue curtain, a lucky-dip bucket, crates of bottled milk on ice. A queue of forty people winds past three shuttered shopfronts. Steam is pouring out of Kotobuki-yu's open door in a great warm cloud, lit gold from inside, and rising up into the black sky over the lantern wires. Small in the middle of all of it, in her indigo happi with an armful of towels, being talked at from three directions at once and pulled a fourth: Nagi, absolutely deadpan. Ban is at the door with a clipboard. A very small boy has a bucket. The palette is hot orange, lantern red, and warm smoke against cold night blue. Every single person in this picture is happy.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-lidded, working the accounts

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: coming through the noren with nothing in his hands for once

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu, Thursday, 8:40pm, warm lamp, an ordinary quiet night
panels.action: He has not come to deliver anything, which is itself unusual.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: flat, not sitting down
chars.pose: laying a folded sheet of paper on the counter and squaring it up with two fingers

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: pen stopping

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp
panels.action: It is already printed. That is the whole conversation, really.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absolutely level

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: already turning to go

panels.bg: counter, noren, night street beyond
panels.action: Her first objection is not about consent. It is about the price of hot water, because it is always about the price of hot water.

panels.bg: the flyer on the counter under the lamp. ART NOTE: layout only, no legible characters. A photocopy of something hand-made — a hand-drawn bathhouse chimney with steam curling off it, a wobbly ruled border, hand-lettered blocks of text at three different sizes, a price in a circle, a smudge where the original was folded. Made with enormous care by somebody who has never designed anything.
panels.action: Six shops, one photocopier, and a meeting on a Thursday at seven that she was told about eight chapters ago.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: nothing at all on her face
chars.pose: looking down at it, hands flat on the counter either side

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Two hundred yen does not cover the water. Everybody who voted for it knows that. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — crouched, back turned
chars.pose: sliding the flyer into the bottom drawer, flat on the lid of the blue box, beside two bundles under bulldog clips

panels.bg: the open bottom drawer under the counter, warm light falling in
panels.action: She does not put it on the wall. She files it with the other paperwork. Silent.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: >_<, tiny body huge head, pointing with total authority
chars.pose: chibi, directing two men carrying a ladder

chars.name: shopkeeper
chars.expression: chibi, sweating, up the ladder
chars.pose: nailing a banner to an awning post

panels.bg: the shotengai, Saturday afternoon, chaos lines, starburst screentone, half-hung lanterns, a banner going up crooked
panels.action: Chibi is permitted out here. The moment anybody goes through that noren the drawing goes fully realistic and stays there.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: chibi, seated on a folding stool with a cash box, supervising the entire street

panels.bg: shotengai, lanterns going up, chibi register, sparkle tone
panels.action: Seventy-eight years old, in charge of money.

panels.bg: the shotengai at 5:30pm, fully drawn, no chibi: lanterns lit down the whole length of the street, stalls open, the banner up, and every shutter that has been down since chapter one now standing open with somebody behind it
panels.action: Two-thirds of this street has been closed since the first page of the series. Tonight all of it is open. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: grim, methodical, dreading it
chars.pose: counting towels into stacks on the counter

panels.bg: changing room before opening, every basket out, all the towels in the building on the counter, warm lamp
panels.action: Eighty-one towels. Forty baskets. A changing room that comfortably holds sixty people.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: already taking her coat off, entirely businesslike
chars.pose: coming in and going straight behind the counter without being invited

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: looking up

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp
panels.action: She does not offer to help. She starts.

dialogue.text: I'll do towels. You'll be needed everywhere else.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: grave, holding a bucket and a cloth, presenting himself for duty
chars.pose: standing at attention beside the massage chair

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: in a Kotobuki-yu happi that is slightly too short in the sleeve, grinning

panels.bg: rest area, the massage chair, warm lamp
panels.action: The post is not offered. The post is claimed.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: >_<, chibi, at the back of an enormous queue with three classmates
chars.pose: chibi, standing on tiptoe to see the front

panels.bg: outside on the street, chibi register, the queue winding past three shuttered shopfronts, lanterns, chaos lines
panels.action: Six o'clock. The queue is already past the dry cleaner's.

dialogue.text: Two hundred yen! It's two hundred yen!

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: fully drawn, expressionless, holding a clipboard and a fistful of numbered wooden tags
chars.pose: planted in the genkan like a man who has run a port

panels.bg: the genkan, sandal rack built for forty pairs, shoes already three deep, warm lamp
panels.action: Inside the building the drawing does not do jokes. It does not need to.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — somewhere in it
chars.pose: moving through the crowd with an armful of towels

panels.bg: the changing room at 6:20pm from the ceiling corner — packed, steam, forty voices, children, old men, schoolkids, baskets stacked on baskets, every square metre of floor occupied
panels.action: A building for sixty.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: thirteen, deadpan, entirely unflustered
chars.pose: at the towel table with two piles and a bin, working at speed

panels.bg: the towel table, wet towels coming back faster than dry ones go out, warm lamp
panels.action: 7:10pm. Eighty-one towels, a hundred and six people so far.

dialogue.text: We're out in about nine minutes.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: already moving
chars.pose: crouched at the low shelf behind the counter

panels.bg: under the counter shelving, and a wooden crate of thick unused towels that has been sitting there since chapter two
panels.action: Delivered wrong. Three times. She never asked what supplier.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: setting the crate down on the towel table

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: looking into it

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: not looking over, tagging shoes
chars.pose: at the genkan, twenty feet away, back turned

panels.bg: towel table and genkan in one frame, crowd, steam, warm lamp
panels.action: Nobody in this building will ever mention where these came from. Silent.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: already redistributing, back at speed

panels.bg: towel table, crowd, warm lamp
panels.action: It buys them ninety minutes.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: absolutely serious, six years old, incorruptible
chars.pose: standing in front of the massage chair with one hand up, blocking a grown man

chars.name: shopkeeper
chars.expression: bewildered, hundred-yen coin held out

panels.bg: rest area, the massage chair with somebody already in it, crowd, warm lamp
panels.action: The chair has an attendant now. The attendant has a system.

dialogue.text: Ten minutes each. He's got four left.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: wiping the vinyl down with enormous concentration between users

panels.bg: the massage chair, rest area, crowd, warm lamp
panels.action: He wipes it down between every single person. Nobody taught him that. He has watched somebody do it four hundred times.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: sleeves soaked to the shoulder, filthy, entirely in his element
chars.pose: coming up the boiler steps two at a time

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: meeting him at the top

panels.bg: the boiler steps and the changing room, steam, crowd noise
panels.action: The machine is at the edge of what it can do and both of them know exactly where that edge is.

panels.bg: the bath hall at 7:40pm — heavy steam filling the upper two-thirds of the frame, the chipped Fuji mural, shoulders and heads only, thirty people in a bath built for a dozen, all of them talking at once
panels.action: Full policy framing: steam, shoulders-up, nothing else visible. It sounds like a football match in there.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: cheerful, shoes in hand, taking his tag from Ban

panels.bg: the genkan, shoes everywhere, Ban with his clipboard, warm lamp, crowd beyond
panels.action: Eight hundred yen for four of them. He has been looking forward to this all week.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: laughing, answering three adults at once, completely in command
chars.pose: behind the towel table in a Kotobuki-yu happi, sleeves shoved back, forearms wet, a stack in each hand

panels.bg: the towel table across a crowded room, steam, warm lamp, Mio working beside him, the whole building running around him
panels.action: What Gonda sees: his best friend, filthy, soaked, in somebody else's happi, being asked questions by grown-ups and knowing all the answers, and happy.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: the grin not arriving yet — half a second where something else goes across his face and is put away
chars.pose: stopped in the middle of the room, shoes still in his hand

panels.bg: crowd, steam, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Half a second. He does not do anything with it. Silent.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: enormous delighted grin, arms folded

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: looking up, going grey

panels.bg: the towel table, crowd, steam, warm lamp
panels.action: There is no confrontation. There was never going to be one.

dialogue.text: So this is the aunt from Chiba.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: nothing available — no bit, no cover, no version of this he prepared for

panels.bg: towel table, crowd, steam
panels.action: One syllable is all he gets out.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: already rolling his sleeves up, not looking at him, picking up a stack

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: watching him do it

panels.bg: the towel table, crowd, steam, warm lamp
panels.action: Two words. Eleven years of friendship, settled, in a queue.

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: already tying an apron behind her back, asking nothing about anything

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: turning, arms full

panels.bg: the packed changing room, steam, warm lamp
panels.action: She has just watched the top student in her year appear from behind a counter in a happi. She has one question and it is not about that.

chars.name: regular
chars.expression: elderly, delighted, both hands round Nagi's wrist
chars.pose: catching her as she passes with an armful of baskets

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: stopped, arms full

panels.bg: the packed changing room, warm lamp, crowd, steam
panels.action: 8:50pm. It starts happening about once every four minutes.

dialogue.text: Thank you for keeping it open.

chars.name: shopkeeper
chars.expression: warm, gripping her shoulder in passing
chars.pose: leaning in to be heard over the noise

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: nodding, level

panels.bg: crowd, steam, lanterns visible through the open door
panels.action: Every one of these sentences is true.

dialogue.text: All on your own, too. All on your own.

chars.name: regular
chars.expression: kind, misty, holding both her hands now

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: face doing nothing whatsoever

panels.bg: close in the crowd, warm lamp, blurred bodies, noise
panels.action: And every one of them stops being true on the thirty-first of March, and she is the only person in the building who knows that.

dialogue.text: Your grandfather would be so proud of you.

chars.name: shopkeeper
chars.expression: up on a crate, bottle in hand, thoroughly enjoying himself
chars.pose: tapping the bottle with a coin for quiet

panels.bg: the packed changing room, the crowd turning, steam, warm lamp, lanterns through the door
panels.action: Somebody taps a bottle. The room does the worst possible thing and goes quiet.

chars.name: shopkeeper
chars.expression: sincere, a bit emotional, doing his best

panels.bg: the crowd from below, faces turned up, steam, warm light
panels.action: It is a good speech. It is about forty seconds long. It is unbearable.

dialogue.text: Sixty-two years this street's had hot water.
Because of one family. To Kotobuki-yu.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absolutely level, and the eyes gone somewhere else entirely
chars.pose: standing in the middle of a hundred and forty people, all of whom are looking at her and clapping

panels.bg: the crowd all round her, hands, faces, noise, steam, warm lamp
panels.action: Work is oxygen. This is not work. This is the other thing.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — small, back turned, at the edge of the frame
chars.pose: slipping through the bath doorway toward the boiler steps

panels.bg: the packed room from the ceiling corner, a hundred and forty people facing the other way, one small figure leaving at the bottom edge
panels.action: Nobody sees her go. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — standing with both hands flat on the boiler casing, head down
chars.pose: alone at the bottom of the steps

panels.bg: the boiler room, bare bulb, pipes, and the noise of a hundred and forty people coming through the ceiling as a warm muffled roar
panels.action: The only quiet left in the building is nine feet under the loudest room in the prefecture. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not crying, not doing anything — just standing there
chars.pose: hands on the casing, forehead nearly against the pipe

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb, muffled roar above
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: arriving at the top of the steps and stopping there
chars.pose: one hand on the frame, not coming down

panels.bg: the top of the boiler steps, warm light and noise behind him, bare bulb below
panels.action: He does not say her name and he does not ask what is wrong.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not looking at her, elbows on his knees
chars.pose: sitting down on the fourth step, a metre and a half away

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not turning round

panels.bg: boiler room and steps, bare bulb, the muffled roar overhead. ART NOTE: compose to echo Ch.8 page 10 panel 1 — same exact distance, him lower and facing away.
panels.action: Ninety seconds. He learned this in this room at four in the morning and he has not forgotten one part of it. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: ordinary, practical, still not looking at her
chars.pose: on the step, thumbing at the ceiling

panels.bg: boiler steps, bare bulb
panels.action: No speech. A job.

dialogue.text: What do I set it to?

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes opening, coming back into the room

panels.bg: boiler, bare bulb, flat screentone
panels.action: It is a question that only one person in the building can answer, which makes her the person who knows things again. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, already crossing to the gauge

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: getting up off the step

panels.bg: boiler room, the gauge, bare bulb
panels.action: Two numbers, and she is upright.

dialogue.text: Forty-four. It'll drop two by nine.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — going up the steps ahead of him

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — following a few steps behind

panels.bg: the boiler steps looking up into warm light and rising noise
panels.action: He never asked her to come back up. He gave her a reason to. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: back in it, working, unreadable
chars.pose: moving through the crowd with a stack of baskets

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: shouting cheerfully at somebody about towels

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: in an apron, ladling something at the door

panels.bg: the packed changing room at 9:30pm, steam, noise, lanterns through the open door
panels.action: Nobody in the room noticed that she was gone for eleven minutes.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: asleep sitting bolt upright with the cloth still in his fist
chars.pose: on the tatami bench beside his chair, out cold

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: putting her own jacket over him without breaking stride
chars.pose: passing with an armful of towels

panels.bg: rest area, the massage chair still going, crowd, warm lamp
panels.action: The attendant has stood his post until 9:41pm. Silent.

panels.bg: the rest area at 10:20pm — every inch of the tatami occupied, kids on the floor, old men with bottles, steam rolling through from the bath, somebody's radio, the fish clock invisible behind heads
panels.action: It has been the loudest ten hours in this building since 1961.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: deep in the chair, eyes shut, entirely at peace in the middle of a riot
chars.pose: milk bottle on her stomach, exactly as always

panels.bg: the massage chair in the middle of the crowd, warm lamp, bodies all round it
panels.action: Sixty-two years. She has not moved from that chair since half past seven.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: stopped beside the chair, arms full, looking out at the room

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: eyes still shut

panels.bg: the chair and the packed room beyond, steam, warm lamp, noise
panels.action: Chapter six, this room, the other way round. She says it first this time.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: wrecked and grinning
chars.pose: flat on his back on the tatami with a towel over his face

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: wrecked and grinning, arm over his eyes
chars.pose: flat on his back beside him

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: still working, stepping over both of them

panels.bg: the rest area at 11:05pm, emptying out, towels everywhere, warm lamp, the noise moving outside to the street
panels.action: A hundred and forty-one people, in a building for sixty, in five hours.

dialogue.text: I want a bath. I work here now.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: handing back the last wooden tag, clipboard under his arm

panels.bg: the genkan, one pair of shoes left, warm lamp, the street loud outside
panels.action: He has stood in that doorway for five hours and tagged a hundred and forty-one pairs of shoes.

panels.bg: the shotengai at 11:20pm seen from the bathhouse doorway — lanterns still lit, the stalls still going, people sitting on crates in the road with bottles, kids running, somebody's speaker, and steam still pouring out over all of it
panels.action: The building is nearly empty. The street is not.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-lidded, methodical
chars.pose: at the counter with the donation box tipped out in front of her, sorting coins into stacks

panels.bg: the bandai counter at 11:52pm, warm lamp, the emptied wooden box, notes flattened under a paperweight, coins in columns, a button and a bottle cap set to one side
panels.action: Somebody put a button in. Somebody always puts a button in.

panels.bg: the open ledger under the lamp, her handwriting entering one figure on tonight's line — and clipped to the facing page, squared, its masking-tape flag still on the corner, the boiler company's estimate sheet with its boxed total. Both numbers are on the same spread. ART NOTE: layout and handwriting shapes only, no legible characters; compositor sets the one narration box.
panels.action: Nobody else in the building is looking at this page. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: face doing arithmetic, and nothing else at all
chars.pose: pen down, hand flat on the page

panels.bg: the counter, warm lamp, and out of focus behind her the open door and a street full of people laughing
panels.action: It was never going to be enough. It was, however, entirely real. Both of those things at full strength. Silent.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: up on a crate in the middle of the road with a bottle raised — the most words he has said in eleven chapters

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: small, stepping out under the noren into the street

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: small, turning to look for her

panels.bg: the full length of the Sakuragawa shotengai at midnight — every lantern lit, every shutter open, a hundred people in the road, steam rolling out of the bathhouse door over all of it, and the black sky above the lantern wires. The loudest panel in the series.
panels.action: Final panel. The building's name, out loud, in a hundred mouths.
